title: Coordinate tower and standard charts for the affine-space trace
statement: For a scheme $S$ [def-pc-scheme], define $X_0(S)=S$ and $X_{d+1}(S)=\mathbf A^1_{X_d(S)}$ [def-sbc-affine-space]. Set $p_0=1_S$ and $p_{d+1}=p_d\circ u_d$, where $u_d$ is the affine-line projection. For $g:S^\prime\to S$ define $g_0=g$ and $g_{d+1}=\mathbf A^1(g_d)$. The canonical coordinate morphism identifies this tower with the recorded affine $d$-space. Its affine restriction over $\operatorname{Spec}B$ has coordinate algebra $B[t_1,\ldots,t_d]$. Each $p_d$ is separated [def-weil-proper-morphism] and finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]; if $S$ is Noetherian then every $X_d(S)$ is Noetherian. For each $T$ use the standard affine chart $j_T:\mathbf A^1_T\hookrightarrow\mathbf P^1_T$ and projection $q_T$ [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change] as a compactification [def-weil-compactifications-refinements] of the line projection, with $q_Tj_T=u_T$. For every $g:T^\prime\to T$, the square of $j_T,j_{T^\prime}$ with the coordinatewise affine and projective base-change maps is Cartesian. If an integer $N$ is invertible on $S$, its images are invertible after arbitrary change of base, on every coordinate stage, and on every projective-line compactification.

proof.text: Construct a morphism to the tower recursively from a base morphism and an ordered Fin d family of global sections, using AffineSpace.homOfVector at each successor. Induction proves that its composite with the tower projection is the given base morphism and that its coordinate pullbacks are the prescribed sections. A second induction using AffineSpace.hom_ext shows that maps to the tower are determined by their base morphism and coordinates. Apply the recursive construction to the universal coordinates on affine d-space. The two coordinate extensionality statements prove both inverse identities for affineTraceToAffineSpace, also for d=0.

Induct on d. The affine-line projection is affine and locally of finite presentation by the existing AffineSpace instances. LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian and QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace give Noetherianity of each successor stage. Separatedness, local finite type and quasi-compactness of the tower projection follow by composition; the initial projection is the identity.

Write the standard projective-line chart as homOfSections for the pair [t:1]. AffineSpace.map pulls this pair back to the same pair on the new base. ProjectiveSpace.comp_homOfSections and hom_ext therefore prove commutativity of the actual chart square. The affine-space projection square and projective-space projection square are Cartesian by their existing isPullback_map theorems. Cancel the latter square from the former rectangle with IsPullback.of_bot to obtain affineTraceChart_isPullback.

For the tower projection, an arbitrary base change morphism, and the projective-line projection, apply IsUnit.map to the corresponding global-sections ring homomorphism. The ring homomorphism preserves the natural-number cast of N, giving each of the three asserted invertibility statements.

proof_origin.place: Steps 5(b) and 6; W2 formal proof using universal coordinates and Cartesian-square cancellation
